column1: # Upstream components of motanka-fonts: the fonts that upstream Omarchy
# v4.5.0 names in its configuration and that Ubuntu's archives do not have.
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there). Installed
#   jetbrains-mono-nerd  Nerd Fonts 3.5.1, the JetBrainsMono release
#                        archive holds its .ttf files, OFL.txt and
#                        README.md without a top-level folder. SHA-256 from
#                        the release's SHA-256.txt, checked against GitHub's
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/fonts-components.tsv
